updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
Release 3.1.8.3

Summary for this release
• Additional updates since the last release, focused on OKB Out workflow reliability, AH-64D/George command handling, TX-Link behavior, and F-14 AIRIO improvements.
• Includes new AID controls, expanded EFB history-track management, and multiple command-flow bug fixes across modules.

Added
• Added OKB Out AID (Aircraft Interface Device) connection with STORES control and new FUEL data block live-feed fuel metrics.
• Added new AH-64D George pilot commands and backend workflow updates.
• Added new AH-64D hot-start pilot takeoff commands and aircraft state monitoring.
• Added new TX-Link implementation with combined-module case logic reworked from scratch.
• Added Jester Wheel visibility external-context commands to manually toggle wheel visibility via voice, button, or key presses in VoiceAttack.
• Added collapsed-run handling for numeric F-14 commands such as Radio Frequency, Laser Code, and Link Tune (requires VoiceAttack profile command updates).
• Added OKB Out EFB Moving Map history-track and persistent track layer management drawer controls.
• Added route-altitude import support in OKB Out DTC Flight Plan import when altitude is specified during DTC construction.

Improved
• Reworked OKB Out Page command and Auto Browse behavior; page commands no longer require Auto Browse to be enabled.
• Refined OKB Out AWACS tab to include active/radiating SAM radars, grouped AIR/SAM/EWR contacts, and sorted-by-range output (AWACS must be on task).
• Added NAVLOG heading toggle support for metric Speed, ALT, and DIST units in OKB Out.
• Updated F-14 AIRIO EGI navigation commands and added a resolver pass to avoid conditional waypoint issues.

Fixed
• Fixed TX-Link short-press behavior and ICS gating.
• Fixed potential loss of function keys due to menuvisible().
• Fixed numerous AH-64 pilot command bugs.
• Minor Hide Menus handling fix to keep communicator availability on affected modules when menus are hidden.
• Removed old debug logging paths.
